newsitem.title: UK: Gilts soar after slew of weak U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Gilts soar after slew of weak U.S. data.

text.p: 1234 GMT - Gilts leapt on the coattails of rallying T-bonds after a slew of U.S. data proved weaker than expected -- durable goods orders fell 3.0 pct (forecast flat) and employment costs rose 0.6 pct (forecast +0.9). Figures may defer need for U.S. rate rise. * June gilt future at 109-18, up 16/32 since data
